text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm walking through the school
building, I spy
Kitasan Black smiling as
she follows a rather
nervous-looking
Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Okay! On your right you can see a
popular spot
among students at the
academy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whenever they feel frustrated after
losing a race,
they yell into the tree
stump!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Got it! Hehe! Okay, next up is... Oh!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, hello! It's so, um, lovely to see
you out and
about!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! It's hilarious watching how
awkward you
two are right now! But it's
all right! There's no
need to be so
formal, so relax!
choice_data_list: こちらこそお世話になっておりまする……？

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Right! Inhale... Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Well, you see...
choice_data_list: ところで何をしてたんだ？
ところで何をしてたの？

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! Unfortunately, I am unable to
attend to
you since I'm on the clock and
working with Prez
today!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Whaaat? Seriously?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but have no fear! My friend,
Special Week,
will fill in for me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
G-greetings! My name is Special Week! I
hope to
be of much help to you today!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! No need to be so proper, Spe!
You're an
upperclassman now, so don't
be afraid to carry
yourself with a little
more dignity!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Teio, my task today is
merely an
inspection, so I do not require
help if you are
busy...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nope! Don't even think about it, Prez! I
already
decided I'd be helping you
today, so you'd better
take me along!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, that's why Spe is filling in for
Teio today!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
As her upperclassman, I thought it'd be

appropriate to give her a guided tour
around the
school! But what else can I
show her? Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So she says, but Kitasan Black has been
at Tracen
for a while, so giving her a
school tour now seems
kind of
pointless...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Psst, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I know what you're thinking, but all I
want right
now is to be pampered by my
kind, reliable
upperclassman!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I think you've basically shown me
everything
there is to see around
campus, so hmm... What
else can we do?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to go partner running with you
and pick
your brain for recommendations
on what to order
at the school cafeteria!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've heard so much about your
achievements and
would love to uncover
the secret of your strength!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: S-sure! Okay, we can do that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't shake the feeling that their roles
as upper
and underclassman have
reversed in terms of
who's leading who...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Which do you think we should do,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black shoots me a meaningful
look. It
seems she wants me to make the
decision so she's
not the one taking the
lead from her
upperclassman.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Let's go, then!
choice_data_list: 併走の相手をお願いしたいかな！
一緒にご飯を食べない？

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's run another lap!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'll definitely cross the finish line
before
you overtake me this time!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, look at that! Kita and Spe are
getting on so
well!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well... I kinda left halfway through. The
whole
time I was out, I couldn't stop
worrying about
those two.
choice_data_list: あれ、君は視察だったはずじゃ……
あれ、貴方は視察だったはずじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I felt bad for having my head in the
clouds while I
was with Prez, so I
decided to come back and put
on my
mantle as a good upperclassman.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, but it seems like I was worrying
over
nothing. No matter who she's
dealing with...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Kita's a pro at getting people to open
their
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
V-very well, but I won't go down that
easy!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Look, Spe! They're serving miso ramen
today!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh... Did you know, Kita? There's also a secret menu!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Believe it or not, you can order a double
portion
of soft-boiled egg from it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wooow! A double portion?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since we've entered her area of
expertise, Special
Week does a 180,
taking on a new air of
seniority.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're incredible, Spe! You know

everything there is to know about food!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Yup! I've got your back when it
comes to
food! Go ahead and order
whatever you want! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It still feels like Kitasan's eagerness to
be
pampered is what's giving Special
Week a bit
more room to flex her
seniority.
